title: Chapter 583
text:
With a strange expression, Han Xiao sized Malekith up from head to toe.

"Are you here to poach me?"

He did not expect to meet a hunter. After all, he was now an officer of Floating Dragon, and normal organizations would not dare to do such a thing. The core officers of Bloodshed Land had come to invite him and even offered him a very high position. He would become one of the Vanguard Officials as soon as he joined, which was a very high position.

Bloodshed Land and Floating Dragon were two different organizations. Floating Dragon had always been supported by Ames alone, and Heber was also a Beyond Grade A Super. Not only that, but he was also the oldest of the four famous Beyond Grade A Supers in the Shattered Star Ring. Pugilists trained one's physique and life force, so his lifespan was very long. Thus, Bloodshed Land also had Floating Dragon's greatest advantage.

Furthermore, Bloodshed Land was an important ally of a Star Cluster civilization. They were rich in resources, had a wide network, and had a very strong armed force. They had many branches in various Star Systems of another Star Cluster. Just their organization alone was already a giant in the Shattered Star Ring. Furthermore, unlike Floating Dragon, they were still active and expanding.

For example, in the previous version of the Wayne Card Shattered Star Ring Deck, there were three cards in the Floating Dragon faction. They were the faction card [Floating Dragon Island], the strong card ['Dragon Emperor' Ames], and the mercenary card [Black Star Mercenary]. There were a total of fourteen cards in the Bloodshed Land faction!

I've been in the limelight recently and displayed my abilities. It should be because of this that I've caught the attention of more powerful people.

Han Xiao nodded. While this was rare, it was not unprecedented. When one's Fame and Legendary Points reached a certain level, there would be a chance of such a thing happening. After becoming famous, all sorts of people would come looking for him.

Bloodshed Land coming to poach him proved that his level had also subtly increased.

"I'm a little curious. Aren't you guys afraid that Ames will be angry?"

Han Xiao curled his lips.

Malekith smiled faintly, containing great confidence.

"Do you think His Excellency Tyrant will be afraid of Ames? Furthermore, this is not the first time. "

Han Xiao's eyes moved, and he became curious.

"You guys poached someone from Floating Dragon before? That person is still alive? "

"Of course he's alive, and he's in a very high position now."

"Ames didn't cause you any trouble?"

"Heh, you know her very well. Indeed, she dragged Floating Dragon Island and attacked our headquarters, so His Excellency Tyrant took action."

"What's the result?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

Malekith pursed his lips, his eyes filled with passion. He chuckled and said, "The original Floating Dragon Island was twice as big as this."

Ames is at a disadvantage … Han Xiaoxin thought.

This was a secret that the players in Han Xiao's previous life did not manage to find out. It turned out that Floating Dragon had a grudge with Bloodshed Land. No wonder they were trying to poach Ames.

Wait, if I reject, I might be viewed as an enemy by the Bloodshed Land?

Han Xiao became vigilant and asked in a deep voice, "Thank you for your invitation, but what if I refuse?"

Malekith's smile disappeared, and he stared at Han Xiao. His tone became unquestionable as he slowly said, "Consider it again."

Black Star's hundreds of thousands of Immortals had already attracted the interest of the Bloodshed Land, but Heber did not bother to poach people slowly. If he wanted to poach someone, he would poach the leader directly. Thus, Han Xiao became the target of recruitment.

Malekith did not want to return empty-handed from a mission personally given by the Tyrant.

This is a threat, right?

Han Xiao frowned and secretly weighed the pros and cons.

If he changed his allegiance to the Bloodshed Land, he would incur the wrath of Floating Dragon. The connections that he had built with Floating Dragon would disappear, and the Black Star Corps and Blue Star would lose the special treatment that Floating Dragon gave him. Ames placed a lot of importance on him, and if he betrayed her, she would be even angrier. The consequences would be dire.

As for the benefits … they seemed to be huge as well. Bloodshed Land's influence was much stronger than Floating Dragon's. What he lost on the swings, he gained on the swings. With the help of the Bloodshed Land, he could rebuild a wider network. At the same time, with the resources of the Bloodshed Land, he could provide greater support to the Black Star Corps, making up for all his losses. The only problem was that he might need to go to the Star Cluster where the Bloodshed Land was.

Since Heber dared to poach me, if Ames succeeded in her revenge, it would be very embarrassing. Thus, Heber would probably protect me …

After thinking for a while, Han Xiao spoke.

"I've thought about it …"

His brows relaxed, and he smiled at Malekith.

"I refuse."

Although he had analyzed the pros and cons out of habit, that was just a habit. From the start, Han Xiao had never planned to leave Floating Dragon. He was not someone who would be swayed by a few words.

Ames had provided so much convenience, and this was all a favor. Their relationship had always been in a warm state. If it were Heber, he would have to rebuild his relationship with his boss. Furthermore, the name 'Tyrant' did not sound easy to get along with. Bloodshed Land had many more rules than Floating Dragon, and it was impossible for them to tolerate him as much as Ames did.

Most importantly … I'm the only leader of the Field Team on Floating Dragon. Only a fool would run over to be your ninth brother!

Malekith's smile completely disappeared, and he stared at Han Xiao with a cold expression.

Han Xiao did not back down and stared back, secretly adjusting his state of mind.

The atmosphere gradually became tense.

Just when he thought that they were going to fight again, Malekith suddenly snorted heavily, turned around, and left.

Han Xiao's expression relaxed, and he let out a sigh of relief.

It seemed like there would not be a fight. This was the crucial stage of the Black Star Corps' development. It was best not to become enemies with Bloodshed Land.

This time, a spaceship with Bloodshed Land's symbol flew over from the horizon. This was Malekith's spaceship, and it had been hiding behind the planet.

Malekith boarded the ramp and suddenly pressed on the hatch that was about to close. He glanced at Han Xiao and said with a low voice.

"Black Star, we will meet again very soon."

Then, he did not care about Han Xiao's reaction and let the hatch close. The Bloodshed Land spaceship quickly took off and disappeared.

Meet again very soon … What does that mean? Is he looking for a chance to deal with me? Or is there another meaning?

"Forget it. Bloodshed Land's territory is not in the Colton Star Cluster anyway, so it's unlikely that they will come over to deal with me. Since Floating Dragon and Bloodshed Land are at peace, they definitely won't make a big move because of me."

Han Xiao shook his head. After thinking it through, he was no longer worried.

"Right, I'm here to hand over the hostages." He suddenly came back to his senses.

After messing around with Malekith for a while, he had almost forgotten the purpose of this trip.

Returning to the side of the galactic pirates' spaceship, Befuli was lying on the ground with a few lightly injured galactic pirates surrounding him. They glanced at the Blacklight Stealth circling in the sky and seemed to be hesitating whether or not to take Befuli away.

Hearing footsteps, these galactic pirates turned around and saw Han Xiao walking over. They shivered at the same time, and fear appeared in their eyes. They froze on the spot, not daring to move.

The original method of handing over the hostages did not require them to meet, and there was a guarantee of safety. However, now that the victim, Han Xiao, was right in front of them, they were afraid that they would lose their lives. Furthermore, Befuli's skinny appearance made them extremely shocked. They did not know what kind of torture Befuli had gone through to become like this. In any case, they did not want to follow in his footsteps.

Han Xiao glanced at them, casually grabbed a galactic pirate, and stepped onto the spaceship. The galactic pirate pointed the way in fear, and the two of them quickly arrived at the prison.

However, the prison was empty.

"Where is he?"

Han Xiao pressed down on the galactic pirate's head and tightened his grip. His tone was unfriendly.

"I — I don't know … They disappeared a day and a half ago!"

The galactic pirate felt that his head was about to explode, and he hurriedly explained.

Disappeared?

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, then realized something and let go of his hand.

F * ck, these bastards went offline!

They probably went to sleep.

Disappeared a day and a half ago. Hmm, that means they should be online soon. I can wait …

Han Xiao realized a problem and squeezed the galactic pirate's head again.

"The hostages disappeared, and you still want to make a deal? Are you playing with me?"

The galactic pirate was about to cry.

Sir, we're all controlled by that demon. How can we inform you?

Also, can you stop squeezing my head? My head hurts!

At this moment, a white light flashed in the prison, and a few Guild of Gods players came online. They immediately saw a huge lump of Black Star and were pleasantly surprised.

"Quick, inform the president. The hidden quest is finally here!"

More than ten seconds later, a series of white lights flashed, and Jupiter and the others all came online. When they saw Han Xiao, they were all overjoyed.

"Back again?" The galactic pirate rubbed his eyes to make sure that he was not hallucinating.

Han Xiao opened the prison, led everyone out of the spaceship, and threw the galactic pirate in his hand to the ground.

"Contact Sykes. Our deal will continue."

As soon as he said that, the fear on the galactic pirates' faces froze and turned into surprise.

The hostages had already been taken away, and they were in Black Star's hands. They had nothing to threaten him with. Under such circumstances, Black Star still wanted to hand over Befuli and let them go?

"You — you still want to continue the deal?" one of the galactic pirates could not help but repeat, finding it hard to believe.

"Why, are you going back on your word?" Han Xiao asked.

"No, no, no, you misunderstood. We'll do as we agreed." The galactic pirates hurriedly denied it with ecstasy on their faces.

One of the galactic pirates hurriedly contacted Sykes and explained the situation to him.

Sykes was shocked. His subordinates had actually been controlled by someone from Bloodshed Land. This was something that he had never expected.

However, even though there was a problem with the deal, Black Star did not go back on his word …

Could it be that his threat was really that effective?

Sykes could only conclude that this was the reason, and he suddenly felt much better.

Ha, a famous expert in the galaxy was scared by him.

Ignoring the negotiations of the galactic pirates, Han Xiao led Jupiter and the others to the side, let the Blacklight Stealth land, and opened the hatch.

"Get on the ship. Risda will bring you to the nearest city planet."

Jupiter's eyes sparkled, and he said passionately, "We want to help you deal with the enemy. Please let us lend you a hand."

It was not easy to come across a hidden storyline. With such a good opportunity, he felt that he would definitely be able to trigger the hidden mission.

You have triggered the hidden mission [Retreat].

Mission Introduction: You have been involved in a storm. However, with your current strength, you are unable to interfere in this matter. Therefore, what you need to do is to retreat from this place as soon as possible.

Mission Requirements: Leave in the Blacklight Stealth.

Reward: 35 EXP, + 200 Black Star Corps Favorability.

"Let's go!" Jupiter turned around and walked into the hatch without hesitation.

The players of the Guild of Gods followed behind and boarded the Blacklight Stealth.

Poseidon approached Jupiter, gave him a thumbs up, and said, "As expected of the president. If we had boarded the ship immediately, we would not have triggered this mission."

Jupiter smiled smugly and pointed at his temple. "This is experience. Learn from it."

Although this mission was a little different from what he had imagined, after reading the mission introduction, Jupiter felt that this might be a high-level event. It was just that they did not meet the requirements to trigger it, which was why it had become the [Retreat] mission. Although it was a pity, he could only do it for now. It was better than nothing.

Han Xiao was still standing outside, waiting for the galactic pirates' reply.

After a while, a galactic pirate ran over and said carefully, "Your Excellency Black Star, if there are no problems, we will leave with Befuli."

"Go. Don't provoke me in the future. I won't let you go next time." Han Xiao waved his hand and boarded the spaceship.

Only then did the galactic pirate heave a sigh of relief. He hurriedly called his companions and activated the spaceship. The thrusters spewed out flames, and the spaceship floated up.

Just as the spaceship was about to accelerate, behind the hatch of the Blacklight Stealth, Han Xiao's eyes shone with a gray light. He activated his racial talent and turned into the Chaos Body. His entire body lost its physical form and turned into a gray fog.

[Advanced Void Travel]!

After entering the Void Vision, time seemed to stop in the outside world. Han Xiao controlled the Chaos Body to leave the Blacklight Stealth. Because the duration of [Advanced Void Travel] was longer, he had plenty of time to cross a large distance and approach the spaceship.

Void Travel had the ability to pass through walls. The Chaos Body directly passed through the hatch of the spaceship and found a remote cabin to hide. Only then did he deactivate Void Travel. He did not trigger the alarm, and the galactic pirates did not discover him.

Hu!
